note: Weeks 1-5 (20 lessons). Signs (the places an activity sorts into), numbered moments (the lines students handle, each cited by chapter) and the few pictures the lessons show: the 1878 Mary Hallock Foote engravings (public domain) and the AI engraving-style figures, credited on the card. Header art and the teacher's portrait are left out. Nothing depicts or describes the mark on the minister's breast.
